## 3.6.5 (HexGhoul): Bikaku: Grand Devouring from inside the mouth (GeckoLib)

HexKagune 3.6.5 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. **The first part of the mod drawn with GeckoLib** (now required).

Your words: "If the victim is another player, they must experience a special first-person perspective from inside the kagune's mouth", and on its first draft: "I like the inside of the mouth, proceed wit hthe mod".

- **A player being eaten now sees the inside of the mouth** in first person:
  - Thick walls of flesh in rings, in the eater's kagune colour, that breathe one ring after another.
  - Rows of bone-white fangs down the walls.
  - The throat going up into darkness, working.
- **The jaws close in step with the world:** a flap of lip for each eighth of the rim, turned by the same jaw opening the worm is drawn with. Wide, they hang out past the rim. Closing, they swing in under you like a funnel and shut out the outside bit by bit, until only the fang tips meet.
- **The gulp:** the rings squeeze one after another, from the mouth on up the throat.
- **It matches the world worm:** it is placed along the very curve the worm is drawn along (round the eater's body, carried with his torso's pose), a little inside its cavity. It shows from as the mouth comes down round your eyes until you are swallowed. In third person you see the world worm as before.
- **Changed to match it:** during the swallow, the worm's head now stays down over the body it holds until it is swallowed, then lifts into its arch. Before, it swung away while the body was still held, which would have put your eyes outside the mouth.
- **How it is made:**
  - The model, animation and texture are generated by `tools/devour_cavity.py`: `assets/hexkagune/geo/devour_cavity.geo.json`, `animations/devour_cavity.animation.json`, `textures/geo/devour_cavity.png`.
  - It is drawn by `client/render/DevourInside` through GeckoLib's own `GeoObjectRenderer`, with GeckoLib's keyframed animation for the breathing and code for the jaws and the gulp.
- Preview (off-game, the model baked as GeckoLib bakes it): `docs/handoff/devour-inside-3.6.5.png`:
  - top: looking down at the jaws, wide to shut;
  - middle: the walls breathing and up the throat;
  - bottom: from outside, cut in half, a player-sized body inside.
- World sheet with the new swallow: `docs/handoff/bikaku-devour-3.6.5.png`.
- **Your words since:** "Grand devouring should not be in the kakuja form by the way." It never starts in the kakuja, and going into the kakuja is refused while a worm feeds, so nothing changed for it. The kakuja version I had planned is dropped.
- **My guesses:**
  - The look: 6 rings of 16 panels, 10 fangs a ring, 8 jaw flaps, a 2.4 s breath.
  - The flaps hanging out and down when wide.
  - The gulp's squeeze.
  - First person only.
  - It starts a little before the mouth reaches the ground.
- **Known limits:**
  - Other sounds can't be muffled (Minecraft gives no way), so the mouth's own sounds play close.
  - It is cube-built, as GeckoLib models are, so it is blockier than the world worm; the texture gives the folds, veins and wet glints.
- Network: protocol 103 (unchanged).
- Tests:
  - New DevourCavityTest (138,186), the model baked as GeckoLib bakes it:
    - every bone the code drives is there;
    - the breathing works every ring;
    - the walls are closed all round at every height all through the breath, so nothing of the outside shows through;
    - the jaws hang past the rim when wide and lie across the hole when shut;
    - a player's eyes stay inside the cavity, as the game places it, from the mouth coming down until swallowed, for every worm of every form.
  - BikakuWormTests (2,419,779), BikakuTests (1,649), the full suite.
- API: GeckoLib 4.8.4 signatures are stubbed and allowlisted from its sources (`[geckolib]` in `verify/api-allowlist.txt`).

Validation: full python3 build.py completed with EXIT 0 (javac --release 17), including the regression suites, API/bytecode and archive checks, and dedicated-server loading checks. Protocol 103. Not tested in game.
